title: Discrete nonlinear Hölder--Brascamp--Lieb inequalities: a local approach
summary: We study nonlinear Hölder--Brascamp--Lieb inequalities over $\mathbb{Z}^n$. Our method embeds the integers into a suitable compactification, over which local Hölder--Brascamp--Lieb theory may be applied (e.g heat flow). Our main result is a bound for multilinear Hölder--Brascamp--Lieb functionals over suitable sublattices in $\mathbb{Z}^n$.
